tests.description: Repeated create returns the same Sandbox for the same digest.
Create rejects reuse with a conflicting request digest.
Controller restart reconstructs desired and observed state.
Expired leases stop new work and trigger termination or reconciliation.
Exec retries reuse the logical operation and append attempts.
Exec cancellation requires evidence and never infers success from intent.
Stale operation attempts cannot mutate Sandbox state.

All 14 token-protected Sandbox operations reject wrong JWS typ, algorithm, key, Provider audience, caller, operation, Contract ID, Digest Profile, request or descriptor digest, Tenant, WorkOrder, Sandbox, Attempt, a token predating PolicyDecision or exceeding deadline, stale fencing and replayed mutation jti.

All 14 token-protected Sandbox operations require one bounded unpadded-base64url JCS Admission Context from the admitted mTLS controller and reject missing, malformed, padded, duplicate, unknown, oversized, caller, Context digest, policy time, target path/query, request/descriptor, Token, stale fencing or replay binding mismatches before repository or driver dispatch. Capability discovery remains mTLS-only and carries neither Context nor operation token.
Status, operation, Exec result, Snapshot manifest and Event reads bind normalized path and query values to operation-specific read descriptors; cursor and target substitution are rejected.
Capability discovery requires admitted control-plane mTLS identity and does not accept or require a nonexistent SandboxOperation token.
Lost responses resolve through status query or reconciliation.
Sandbox cannot enter host namespaces.
Sandbox workload cannot access Kubernetes credentials or API.
Cloud instance metadata is unreachable.
Cross-tenant network paths are denied.
Cross-tenant storage paths are denied.
Sandbox can write only admitted staging locations.

Exec rejects uncovered Secret references and only consumes a sender-constrained single-use Credential delivery for the exact request; material is absent from cache, disk, logs, events, traces, snapshots and recordings.
Provider API or controller failover preserves fencing and reconciliation.
Node loss produces recoverable or explicitly failed Sandbox state.
Sandbox usage entries bind MeterDefinition, WorkOrder and immutable evidence.
Workspace snapshot bytes, manifest digest and restored WorkspaceRevision content match exactly.
Cross-revision workspace restore emits immutable evidence for the exact source and target revisions and profile.
Missing, failed or mismatched CompatibilityDecision blocks restore before dispatch.
Each admitted filesystem source-to-target Provider/runtime pair passes the declared compatibility matrix.
Each admitted process snapshot pair verifies architecture, runtime, image and kernel-sensitive restore evidence without wildcard compatibility.
